benchmark.name: FEM-Bench 2025 — First Run

summary.en: FEM-Bench tests first-attempt scientific Python implementations for finite-element and structural-analysis tasks.
summary.zh: FEM-Bench 测试模型首次生成有限元与结构分析 scientific Python 实现的能力。

task_format.en: The model completes one numerical function for each of 33 FEM and structural-analysis tasks.
task_format.zh: 模型为 33 个有限元与结构分析 task 分别补全一个数值函数。

explanation.en: A task passes only if the first function parses, executes, uses allowed imports, and passes every hidden numerical check.
explanation.zh: 只有首次生成的函数可解析、可执行、仅用允许的 import，并通过全部隐藏数值检查，task 才通过。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
